messages:
alex: quick repro — async python client fails SSL verify when using HTTP proxy + base_url pointed at Dedicated. Repro below. anyone seen this?

alex: ```python
import os
from redwood import AsyncClient
os.environ['HTTP_PROXY'] = 'http://proxy.internal:3128'
client = AsyncClient(base_url='https://dedicated-123.internal:443', verify='/etc/certs/team-ca.pem')
await client.generate('hello')
```

alex: failing with: SSLHandshakeError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed

maria: do you pass an absolute path and is the bundle a full chain (root+intermediate)? httpx sometimes needs an SSLContext for chained bundles. also check REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE vs SSL_CERT_FILE vs certifi.

alex: absolute path, bundle has root+intermediate. weirdly it only fails when HTTP_PROXY is set. without proxy + same base_url it verifies fine. with proxy and same CA it fails.

samir: probably our async adapter/transport is not wiring the ssl context through when trust_env/proxy is active. httpx ProxyTransport can re-wrap sockets. can you paste `pip freeze` + python version?

alex: python 3.11.4, httpx==0.24.1, certifi==2024.5.2, redwood-sdk==0.8.3

alex: extra debug snippet (HTTP_PROXY set):
```
[DEBUG] httpx._exceptions.SSLError: SSLHandshakeError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed (_ssl.c:1007)
[DEBUG] using proxy http://proxy.internal:3128 for https://dedicated-123.internal:443
```

maria: can you try constructing an SSLContext and passing it as `ssl` instead of verify? `import ssl; ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile='/etc/certs/team-ca.pem')` then AsyncClient(..., ssl=ctx) — if that works we know verify path wasn't propagated into the proxy transport.

alex: tried `ssl=ctx` — that fixed it locally. seems like a propagation bug indeed.

samir: thanks, good repro and useful workaround. i'll open a patch. suspect code path: AsyncHTTPTransport -> proxied socket wrapping loses `ssl` arg and falls back to default context. i'll PR a fix that ensures `ssl`/`verify` is forwarded into ProxyTransport. will add a unit that reproduces with a mock proxy.

ci-bot: integration-tests/py-client-proxy failing on macos-ssl in main · see job #4521 for logs

samir: PR opened: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2345 (branch fix/httpx-proxy-ca-async). includes: forward ssl context, add sample for dedicated + proxy + custom-ca, test matrix entry for httpx 0.24 and 0.25.

alex: tested branch — :thumbsup: fixes the HTTP_PROXY case, still seeing rare failure when the CA bundle contains a cross-signed intermediate. adding `ctx.load_verify_locations('/etc/certs/team-ca.pem')` fixes it. maybe worth documenting nuance in onboarding docs.

devex-oncall: noted — will add a short blurbit in the Dedicated/VPC quickstart: "If using a custom CA behind a forward proxy, prefer supplying an SSLContext (ssl=...) or ensure bundle includes full chain; see sample app x" :calendar:

samir: will merge after CI green and add a tiny sample to devex-samples showing both `verify='path'` and `ssl=context` patterns for async and sync clients. thanks for the clear repro, alex.

alex: thanks y'all — saved me a lot of hair. please ping when merged so we can update our infra playbook.
